statement: The points $A(2,1)$, $B(6,4)$ and $C(8,0)$ form a triangle. Find its area and the equation of the line through $A$ parallel to $BC$.
solution: Area $=\\tfrac12|2(4-0)+6(0-1)+8(1-4)|=\\tfrac12|8-6-24|=\\tfrac{22}{2}=11$. Gradient of $BC=\\tfrac{0-4}{8-6}=-2$, so the line through $A$ has gradient $-2$: $y-1=-2(x-2)$, i.e. $y=-2x+5$.
hints: Use the shoelace (determinant) formula for area.
Parallel lines share the same gradient.
